description: Source code for an email-based CRM case management script in OpenERP, including classes for email parsing, RPC communication, and email handling functions.

classes.name: rpc_proxy
classes.description: Handles XML-RPC communication with the OpenERP server.

classes.name: email_parser
classes.description: Parses and processes incoming emails, manages CRM cases, and sends email responses.

methods.name: rpc_proxy.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the RPC proxy with server details and credentials.

methods.name: rpc_proxy.__call__
methods.description: Executes an RPC request on the server.

methods.name: email_parser.__init__
methods.description: Initializes email parser with user credentials, section, and server info.

methods.name: email_parser.email_get
methods.description: Extracts email address from a string.

methods.name: email_parser.partner_get
methods.description: Retrieves partner info based on email.

methods.name: email_parser.msg_new
methods.description: Creates a new CRM case from an email.

methods.name: email_parser.msg_body_get
methods.description: Extracts body and attachments from email message.

methods.name: email_parser.msg_user
methods.description: Updates a case based on email commands.

methods.name: email_parser.msg_partner
methods.description: Opens a case based on email reply.

methods.name: email_parser.msg_test
methods.description: Tests for existing case by ID.

methods.name: email_parser.parse
methods.description: Main method to parse incoming email and route to case creation or update.
